name: glob-input
title: Glob Input
description: Glob field that matches the pattern live against the files you pass, flags no-match and match-everything patterns, the * vs ** mix-up that skips subfolders, ** glued to a name, ./ and backslashes, with one-tap fixes. Dependency-free matcher with {a,b} expansion.

meta.summary: Runs a config glob live against your real file list, so a pattern that silently misses files, or matches everything, shows up while you type.
catches: * used where ** was needed, skipping subfolders
limits: Its own matcher; tools such as webpack, tsconfig, git or picomatch differ on edge cases (negation, dotfiles, extglobs)
Only as accurate as the file list you pass in
Case-insensitive by default; set caseSensitive for Linux/git behaviour
a11y: Visible label tied to the input; input is described by the status
Status is a polite live region
Match list is a labelled list with icon labels ("matches"/"no match"), not colour alone
List animation is skipped under reduced motion
